children: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. reported results for 2026 with revenue up 11.2% to $3.12B and diluted earnings per share rising to $1.07, supported by strength in equipment rental demand and higher rates.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Total revenue rose 11% year-over-year to $3,115M, driven by 13% equipment rental growth and stronger rates and volumes.
North America Specialty led segment performance with a 25% increase, supported by higher OEC and ancillary fees; General Tool grew 7% while the UK was modestly down 1%.
Fleet operating equipment capacity (OEC) increased about 6% and dollar utilization was steady or improving (North America Specialty at 77%).

Management increased capital spending and completed acquisitions to expand fleet capacity; seasonality, construction cycles and storm-related demand were key drivers while higher fuel and repair costs weighed on operations.
Sunbelt continued to solidify its market position as the No. 2 rental provider in North America and No. 1 in the UK by rental revenue; a U.S. listing was completed in March 2026.
